parameters.query: =INSERT INTO run_log (job_id, level, step, detail) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), '{{ ($('Parse FB liveness').first().json.fbNeedsAttention || ($('Preflight env check').first().json.hasIg && $('Parse IG liveness').first().json.igNeedsAttention)) ? 'warn' : 'info' }}'::"LogLevel", 'upload'::"LogStep", $1::jsonb);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'mkt_meta_token_health', jobId: $('Preflight env check').first().json.jobId, fb: { alive: $('Parse FB liveness').first().json.fbAlive, name: $('Parse FB liveness').first().json.fbName, needsAttention: $('Parse FB liveness').first().json.fbNeedsAttention, reason: $('Parse FB liveness').first().json.fbReason, error: $('Parse FB liveness').first().json.fbError }, ig: $('Preflight env check').first().json.hasIg ? { alive: $('Parse IG liveness').first().json.igAlive, username: $('Parse IG liveness').first().json.igUsername, needsAttention: $('Parse IG liveness').first().json.igNeedsAttention, reason: $('Parse IG liveness').first().json.igReason, error: $('Parse IG liveness').first().json.igError } : null, threadsRefreshed: $('Preflight env check').first().json.hasThreads }) }}
